shots.action: Wide on the Vault: the Ledger lectern, the orrery, the black hole through the dome. MegaZroN small, back to camera. Turns, sees us, sighs
Slow push-in to a mid shot. Presents himself, one hand to the Ledger
Over his shoulder onto the orrery: six lights in a ring. Points; the six lights drift apart on "Then the worst"
Insert on the Ledger. His hand writes; the ink glows and settles
Close on his face. Amused, a little tired; he waits for us to try

lines.text: Oh good. Another one. Wipe your feet. This is the edge of a black hole and I have just had it cleaned.
I am MegaZroN, keeper of the Last Ledger. I write down how every story ends. Yes, yours. No, you may not see it.
Six friends are about to have the funniest day of their lives. Then the worst. It's a tight schedule.
Everything you do goes in here. Who you trust, and how many times you walk into a tree.
Go on, then. Try to surprise me. Nobody has in nine thousand years, but I do love watching people try.
